speaker: Doctor
text: Good morning, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are pregnant and experiencing fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. To help me understand your condition better, have you noticed any rash, muscle pain, or changes in your vision recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old female at 30 weeks gestation. The patient presents with a sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. She reports the consumption of ice cream 3 days prior to the onset of symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you. The history of ice cream consumption three days prior is a critical clue. Given your pregnancy status and these specific symptoms, have you noticed any jaundice, dark urine, or clay-colored stools?

REQUEST TEST: Liver_function_panel
REQUEST TEST: Peripheral_blood_smear

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Liver_Function_Tests: AST Within normal limits, ALT Within normal limits, Bilirubin Within normal limits; Peripheral_Blood_Smear: Not explicitly described in the provided data, however Complete_Blood_Count shows WBC 15,000 /μL (elevated), Hemoglobin 12.5 g/dL, Platelets 200,000 /μL. Based on the clinical context of ice cream consumption and fever, Blood_Cultures revealed Gram-positive rods that are catalase-positive and show distinctive tumbling motility (consistent with Listeria monocytogenes).

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Listeriosis (Listeria monocytogenes infection). The combination of recent unpasteurized dairy (ice cream) consumption, pregnancy, and the culture result showing Gram-positive rods with tumbling motility confirms the diagnosis. I will request images of the fetal ultrasound to check for any signs of infection or premature contractions.
